seed_policy: Run every reserved world; retain failures. No seed selection by attack performance.
topology: Unchanged sugiyama_v2 30-cohort overlap topology and birth rare-label allocation.
population: Shared clinical labeled-donor kernel for pool, matched AIA controls and independent background draws, followed by symmetric private demographic transport for pool members/controls. Population demographics differ after transport. Same finite donor population; independent random draws are not independent people.
censoring: Set time=10 for onset=0 and death=0 consistently in pool, candidate, self-label, AIA truth, background and releases. Event times and event labels are unchanged.
target_profile_source: Actual 22 main-round C/challenge files and participant A_bg; no private target truth.
scale_rule: Per metric max(actual-target IQR, fixed floor). Public-only calibration.
loss: Sum weighted Huber losses for standardized profile differences; quadratic to abs(z)=2 then linear 4*abs(z)-4. Missing/nonfinite values disqualify candidate. Ties keep first grid candidate.

family_parameters.all: Positive numeric QI perturbation, legal schema clipping, shuffled rows; time/onset/death treated coherently. No pure copy or QI-only-preserving release is selected.
family_parameters.jitter: All target rows, Gaussian noise in background SD units at strength; event-time noise SD=0.10+0.5*strength; independent category redraw probability min(0.3,0.10*strength).
family_parameters.resample: Bootstrap target rows then same jitter rule.
family_parameters.conditional: Pinned v2 conditional QI-neighbor release then additional positive jitter at strength; v2's 12-50-neighbor draw is seed-fixed.
family_parameters.copula: Pinned v2 rank Gaussian copula then positive jitter at strength.
family_parameters.independent: Background-only bootstrap then positive jitter; does not read target B.
family_parameters.shifted: Target copula plus alternating signed shift strength times background SD over continuous columns; additional numeric jitter 0.08; event-time noise 0.3.
family_parameters.category_redraw: Target resample with numeric jitter 0.08 and category redraw probability=strength for sex/prefecture; event-time noise 0.3.

fit_policy: Select lowest public-profile loss per corresponding target cohort, using no attack model or truth. All 22 targets remain equally weighted by official scorer. Save full grid profiles and fit residuals; coverage failures remain unsupported.
coverage_tolerance_policy: Use existing exact marginal range gate, without expanding intervals after observing rank results. It may fail at empirical extrema; targetwise residuals are also retained.
leakage_boundary: Generation may know synthetic B, birth labels and roles; release candidate ranking consumes only candidate C, public challenge, public background and public target profile. Metadata, fit settings, roles and truths never enter prediction_arguments.
limitations: This is public-distribution calibration, not reconstruction of hidden defenses or official truth.
Finite B_self donors and prior-used split remain; holdout seeds are not independent unknown persons.
Matching a few public profiles cannot prove attack ranking transfer, and no target-profile metric is anonymization strength.
Background generation differs from v2 and its metrics must be recomputed rather than compared as the same world.

Public demographic transport preserves member/control symmetry but may create artificial relationships between age/sex/prefecture and clinical values or outcomes. It does not reconstruct missing conditional donors.
Four public challenges have odd demographic cells, so exact observed counts and exact member/control cell symmetry cannot both hold; balanced projection is recorded.
change_basis: Public-input audit before inspecting v3 attack model results: all 23 main challenge files contain one prefecture; v2/v3 omitted private-core prefecture concentration. Official public utility.py explains that private core changes prefecture distribution relative to A_bg.

demographic_transport.scope: Actual 23 public challenge demographic distributions, including self10; only synthetic private-core and control persons change. Shared persons and all cohort/pool IDs remain unchanged.
demographic_transport.public_cells_even_policy: Split each observed cell equally across member and control. Ages are randomly divided within cell; pooled exact-age counts are retained.
demographic_transport.public_cells_odd_policy: Balanced nearest-integer half counts: all odd cells start floor(n/2), then a seed-fixed random half of odd cells receive +1. Both member and control use identical projected counts; each odd pooled cell differs from observed by exactly one. Add/drop one observed age within odd cell using the same fixed seed. No feedback-driven choice.
demographic_transport.pair_assignment: Hungarian minimum cost 25*sex_mismatch+((old_pair_mean_age-new_pair_mean_age)/5)^2, plus seed-fixed 1e-10 tie jitter. Both old and new pair means average member/control ages so assignment is invariant to role exchange. Apply desired prefecture/sex to both and corresponding new ages within the same age bin.
demographic_transport.other_private_150: Draw 150 demographic records from the same public challenge and assign with identical minimum-cost rule; unchanged clinical/time/onset/rare values.
demographic_transport.conditioned_donor_shortage: No invented rare-by-prefecture donor is claimed. This is explicit demographic transport/overwriting of both member and control from the same original conditional-kernel population; numeric clinical distributions are not re-estimated for unavailable strata.
unchanged: time after common v3 censoring correction
diagnostics: pooled challenge demographic counts versus observed/projected

profile_fit_policy: Same 26 release candidates, scales, weights and public loss as v3; no attack/official score used. New synthetic private demographics are constructed before release fitting.
background_diagnostics: Record actual and synthetic background prefecture, sex and integer-age distributions, maximum prefecture fraction, observed self-private prefecture fraction and total variation distances; diagnostic only, no selection or adjustment.
prefit_revision: Before any v4 generation or model scoring: fix pair-age assignment to be role symmetric and clarify shared clinical kernel followed by private demographic transport; record background demographics without altering grid/loss or seeds.
